---
title: "Western Australia"
subtitle: "General Government Sector fiscal positions"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

JURIS <- "WA"

facts <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_latest) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_capita <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_capita) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_gsp <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_gsp) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

# Friendly status label so legends say "Actual" / "Forecast" not TRUE/FALSE.
status_lbl <- function(b) {
  ## Always return character (even on 0-length input) so bind_rows
  ## across possibly-empty per-capita / per-GSP panels doesn't blow
  ## up with type mismatch.
  out <- ifelse(b, "Forecast", "Actual")
  as.character(out)
}

# Small helper: build a single-variable timeline plot.
sbm_state_plot <- function(d, title) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0L) {
    return(htmltools::p(htmltools::em(paste0(title, ": no data extracted yet."))))
  }
  d <- d |>
    arrange(fiscal_year) |>
    mutate(status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate))
  plot_ly(d,
          x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
          color = ~status,
          colors = c(Actual = "#1f3a93", Forecast = "#a6611a"),
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(width = 2.5),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>") |>
    plotly::layout(
      title  = title,
      font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
      margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 50L, b = 70L),
      xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
    )
}
```

## Headline aggregates

```{r rev}
if (nrow(facts) > 0L)
  sbm_state_plot(facts |> filter(variable_id == "rev_total"),
                 paste(JURIS, "--- Total revenue"))
```


## Drill-down

Pick a variable and a normalisation view.

```{r drill}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No data.")
} else {
  long <- bind_rows(
    facts      |> transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, category,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_aud_mil,
                            view   = "AUD millions"),
    per_capita |> transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, category,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_per_capita_aud,
                            view   = "AUD per capita"),
    per_gsp    |> transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, category,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_share_gsp * 100,
                            view   = "% of GSP")
  ) |>
    arrange(canonical_label, fiscal_year)

  shared <- SharedData$new(long)
  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("var",  "Variable",      shared, ~canonical_label,
                    multiple = FALSE),
      filter_select("view", "Normalisation", shared, ~view,
                    multiple = FALSE)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value,
            color = ~status,
            colors = c(Actual = "#1f3a93", Forecast = "#a6611a"),
            type  = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            line  = list(width = 2.5),
            hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
      plotly::layout(
        font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15, title = list(text = "")),
        margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 30L, b = 70L),
        xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
        yaxis  = list(title = "", tickformat = ",")
      )
  )
}
```

## All variables

```{r table}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No data.")
} else {
  facts |>
    arrange(category, canonical_label, fiscal_year) |>
    transmute(
      Category = category,
      Variable = canonical_label,
      `FY`     = fiscal_year,
      `Value (AUD mil)` = round(value_aud_mil),
      Status   = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
      Source   = document_id
    ) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        `Value (AUD mil)` = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE))
      )
    )
}
```
